# ghost/vector-pinball

Vector Pinball (F-Droid): pick a table, start a game, launch the ball, work the flippers, end the game, read high scores. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/vector-pinball
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/vector-pinball start_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/vector-pinball flip --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/vector-pinball end_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/vector-pinball select_table --device <serial> --param steps=<steps>
ghost skill run ghost/vector-pinball get_status --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `start_game`: Start a pinball game
- `flip`: Flip both pinball flippers five times
- `end_game`: End the pinball game
- `select_table`: Switch to the next pinball table
- `get_status`: What are my pinball high scores?
